metadata.title: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Fall in Tech Selloff. A Crypto Bombshell Should Have Helped.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Cybersecurity Stocks Tumble in Tech Selloff. A Crypto Bombshell Should Have Helped.
What looks like the largest hack in history should have boosted cybersecurity stocks on Friday, but an unstoppable stock market selloff had other plans.
